notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages with haste.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

uses.name: Helm of the Host
uses.cardState: attached to Scholar of the Ages
